name: filmai
description: filmai AI film studio: shoot video, images and sound, review takes, audit scripts, and get a price quote before anything is generated.

interface.longDescription:
filmai is an AI film studio for directors. Connect your filmai account and ask your agent to shoot a scene with your own cast, generate stills and sound, review takes, or audit a script. Every generation runs only after you confirm it. Keep a consistent face across a whole film with actors from your casting library, see why takes get rejected (twins, look drift, position swaps, physics glitches), and get a structural diagnosis of any scene with the smallest fix.

電影大師是給導演的 AI 片廠。連上你的電影大師帳號,就能請 agent 用你的定妝演員拍戲、出圖、配音、審片、健檢劇本。每一次生成都要你確認才會送出。
defaultPrompt: Write a shot prompt for a rainy neon-lit street chase.
Audit the structure of this scene and tell me the weakest point.
Review the takes in my latest project and list the ones to reshoot.
